column1: This library is put together for research purposes by Demetrios Pagonis, Kanako Sekimoto and Joost de Gouw. It can be accessed at tinyurl.com/PTRLibrary
column5: Please add comments or suggested additions to the spreadsheet, or send to: Joost.deGouw@colorado.edu
column12: A paper describing this library has been published: Pagonis, D., Sekimoto, K. and de Gouw, J. A.: A library of proton-transfer reactions of H3O+ ions used for trace gas detection, J. Am. Soc. Mass Spectrom., 2019, doi.org/10.1007/s13361-019-02209-3. For specific data from this library, please cite the referenced papers.
